items.title: Smiths Group (LSE:SMIN) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump On Split Analyst Revisions
items.summary: Smiths Group is back in focus after a cluster of new price targets, ranging from 2,675 GBp to 3,150 GBp, reset expectations around what the shares might be worth. These targets reflect a split analyst view, with some highlighting margin potential and capital returns, and others pointing to execution risks and a share price that already tracks close to fair value.
